question: In 1809, Lord ______ signed the Amritsar Treaty with Maharaja Ranjit Singh.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Charles T. Metcalfe**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Treaty of Amritsar:

 
 
• It was an agreement between the British East India Company and Maharaja Ranjit Singh, the Sikh leader who founded the Sikh empire.
 
• Treaty of Amritsar, (April 25, 1809), a pact concluded between Lord Metcalfe, representing the British East India Company, and Ranjit Singh, head of the Sikh kingdom of Punjab.
 
• The Treaty of Amritsar marked the beginning of the Dogra rule in Kashmir.
 
• During First Anglo-Sikh War, Maharaja Gulab Singh Jamwal (Dogra) helped the British Empire against the Sikhs.
 
• After the defeat of the Sikh Empire, The Treaty of Lahore (9 March 1846) and the Treaty of Amritsar (16 March 1846) was signed.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Lord Cornwallis:

 
 
• He was the First English Nobleman to come to India.
 
• He undertake the office of the Governor General and also the first of Parliamentary Governor Generals of India.
 
• He was also the First Governor General to die in India {during his second term}.
 
 
 
• Lord Hastings:
 
 
• He served as Governor General of Bengal from 1813 to 1823, a long ten years term.
 
• His tenure is known for his policy of intervention and war.
 
 

 
• William Bentinck (1828-1835):

 
 
• The Governor-General of India, William Bentinck (1828-1835) abolished Provincial Courts of Appeal and Circuit in 1831__.
 
• Provincial Courts of Appeal and Circuit were established by Lord Cornwallis(1786-1793)
 
• He first replaced them with Commissions and later handed those responsibilities to District Judges and District Collectors.
 
• Sati was abolished in the year 1829.
